comments.text: Cory, you have no idea how much this video means to me. I am currently battling terminal cancer, 4th stage lung cancer. I have chemos every Monday, and I am beat for the rest of the week. Sadly I don't have the strength to celebrate New Years Eve like I used to, so all I can do is huddle by the computer after putting my child to bed. Seeing the notification to your SSS series made me smile so hard for the first time this whole week. I love your content so much, you always bring such brightness and energy to my life, and I am forever thankful. I was following you from the very start- and I am so amazed by how far you've come. I know you won't see this comment because it'll get drowned by tons of others, but just know you made a sick man's year. Happy New Year Cory, never change. ❤
